data: How were the trees plotted, and how does it influence the figure?

The trees in the figure are plotted using circles and lines. The circles represent nodes, and the lines represent branches connecting these nodes. The left part of the figure shows the tree comment network, while the right part shows the decision tree model. The decision tree model uses red and white circles to indicate whether a condition is met ("yes") or not ("no"). The lines connecting the circles in both parts of the figure represent the flow of logic or decision-making process. The use of circles and lines helps to visualize the hierarchical structure of the trees and the logical relationships between different conditions. The decision tree model on the right side influences the figure by providing a structured way to evaluate the credibility of each node in the tree comment network, which aids in discovering evidence.
